title: Moonlight Mango Parade
concept: An original, upbeat call-and-response song about sharing fruit at a friendly nighttime parade.
lyrics:
Moonlight mango, bright and sweet,
Clap your hands and tap your feet.
Share a slice with every friend,
Our happy parade will never end!
visual_direction: Original colorful paper-cut jungle animals marching beneath a moonlit sky; no branded characters, no reference footage, and no resemblance to another channel's work.
